description: What ships that no line in this repository says (run-ai/runai-actions Renovate pipeline, renovate/README.md#attribution). Pinned libraries are marked where they are pinned: .devcontainer/Dockerfile, cpp/MODULE.bazel, .devcontainer/gcs/MODULE.bazel.

components.name: gcc-runtime
components.reason: libstdc++ and libgcc, linked statically into every native library; Ubuntu 20.04's gcc-9 (the devcontainer's base image)

components.name: glibc-nonshared
components.reason: libc_nonshared.a start-up stubs, linked statically; Ubuntu 20.04's glibc 2.31

components.name: nvidia-cuda-headers
components.reason: cuda.h, compiled against (libcuda is loaded at run time); its license asks for the notice. Installed by .devcontainer/scripts/install-cuda-headers.sh; no Renovate datasource serves NVIDIA's redistributables, so update both together
